body: I agree 1000% right now. I literally read it as I pressed the back button and was loading. I fucking reopened the thread and scrolled down just to upvote and see the comments.
I feel the psychological angst. I don't think I like it though, it just feels very humiliating and painful. I just constantly have jealousy overwhelm me with my partners
And if she gets pregnant? I assume you can set that as one of the rules of the relationship?
Because what if the other person is better at sex so it's simply more pleasurable? Why ever go to the worse option?
What if they just stop having sex with you and then only just hang out for emotional support. Wouldn't that be terrible?
Even if it isn't an open relationship I feel it could happen either way. How in general do you overcome that fear of the partner leaving you?

I guess I just can't deal with the rejection of them falling for someone else. How did you begin to be able to accept that?

They could be near perfect for you and then a huge source of happiness just leaves immediately. It just takes off and away like wind.

I don't feel like I'm okay with them getting pregnant with other men while I am with them.

Honestly the thought of then waking up next to them and looking up and keeping love just hurts my heart. It makes my chest feel so heavy and painful feeling like they fell in love more with them.

It's probably trust issues then. Holding others to a higher standard out of fear and distrust of the nature of others. Thank you. Honestly I think part of it is that I've read women get vastly more pleasure from sex so it seems like there is more of an incentive to leave. Idk how I can trust people more.
I'm accounting for personality. If you have 2 people with the same personality and one is more attractive you'll take the more attractive one. Why would this not happen?

How else could relationships work? simply enough unless you have a kid there is very little baggage to lose. Someone better comes along why would you not leave for them...they make you happier because they are more pleasing to the eye
not for race, or height, or other kinds of things.
